questions: How many vortices, islands, samples and cooldowns did you measure with spectroscopy, and how many showed the zero-bias peak together with the integer ladder of Fig. 3G?
Why were the others set aside, and how did you pick the "defect-free region" and the vortex shown in Figs. 2 and 3 (are they the same vortex)?
Which fields, temperatures and setpoints did you measure beyond the 1.0 T, 0.4 K data shown, and which field values do Figs. 4B-D correspond to?
What does the second-best vortex look like? Spectra through the vortices of Figs. 4B-D, and through vortices in other islands, would answer this directly.

Your text gives a level spacing of "about 0.7 meV", while the fitted levels in Fig. 3G differ by about 0.8 to 1.2 meV. How many peaks did the multi-peak fit allow, and how well does a half-odd-integer ladder (no level at zero) fit the same core spectrum?
Does the zero-bias peak height or width change with tunnel coupling (your Fig. 2I uses 500 pA and Fig. 3B-E uses 1 nA), with temperature, or with field?
In the two- and three-vortex islands of Fig. 4, what are the vortex spacings, and does the zero-bias peak stay at zero or split as vortices come closer?
Your text says vortex number is set by "the lateral size of Bi2Te3 islands" as well as by field. Which data show the island-size dependence, given that the Fig. 4 caption lists only field?
